stem.text: The diagram shows a block P of mass $M$ connected by a string over a frictionless pulley to a block Q of mass $m$.

stem.alt: Diagram of a block labelled P on a slope at angle θ to the horizontal, connected by a string running parallel to the slope over a pulley at the top of the slope to a hanging block labelled Q.

stem.text: Block P moves up the slope with a constant velocity $v$. The slope is at angle $\theta$ to the horizontal.
The acceleration of free fall is $g$.
The resistive forces on the blocks are negligible.
Which expressions give the energy transferred per unit time to block P?
